Veterans Benefits: Beginning tax year 2026 Georgia exempts up to $65,000 of military retirement pay regardless of age. Georgia also provides a disabled-veteran homestead property-tax exemption for qualifying 100% service-connected disabled veterans and eligible survivors, with the amount adjusted annually.

Description: Albany is a Southwest Georgia city built around Marine Corps Logistics Base Albany, a major Marine Corps supply and maintenance installation. It offers an in-city VA outpatient clinic, Georgia's expanded military-retirement tax exclusion, the lowest housing costs in this batch (typical home about $128,000), and Walmart access. Tradeoffs include a high crime rate, hot humid summers, and no local Costco.
